literal_meaning: অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ যা কঠিনতা বা স্থিরতা প্রকাশ করে (stiff or numb sound imitation)
figurative_meaning_en: Frightened and stiff or awkward due to fear
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভূমিকম্পের খবর শুনে গ্রামের সবাই জড়সড় হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Upon hearing the earthquake news, everyone in the village froze stiff with fear.
The students were scared stiff in the exam hall.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in spoken Bengali to describe a state of paralysis from fear.
